ground_truth.notes: 16-week first half marathon plan for a runner at 25 mpw. Week 1 should be close to current base (25-28mi). Peak week should land 35-42mi — appropriate for a first HM without overtraining. Long run must build toward 12-14 miles to prepare for the 13.1mi race; capping it at 10mi would leave her underprepared. Tempo work is important for half marathon pace development. 5 sessions/week matching training days.
